description: Made predominantly for Street riding, the Optimium from Stay Strong features everything you need to hit the streets with confidence. Firstly the Optimum is spec'd out with exclusively sealed bearings meaning that everything is solid, lightweight and requires minimal maintenance. This Model features a fully sealed 9t cassette and 2-piece bars making it perfect for street, park and anything else you can throw at it (if you want a pure street bike check out the Freecoaster Model). The parts package is impressive and includes a sealed female axle front wheel, Sealed 3-piece cranks, a fat padded combo seat and post and wide 2.4" gum tires to mention just a few. The bike has a 20.75" top tube so would be a good fit for any rider between 5ft and 6ft and has a short rear end and steep head tube making it super-responsive especially when it comes to carving out 180's and threes etc. Also worthy of a mention on this bike are the removable brakes/mounts and Cr-mo front end which isn't normally standard features you find on a bike at this price point and really helps this stand out from the competition. ###section### Product Specs FRAME MATERIAL: Chromoly Top tube & Down tube WHEEL SIZE: 20" TOP TUBE LENGTH: 20.75" CHAIN STAY LENGTH: 13.25" HEADTUBE ANGLE: 75° SEAT TUBE ANGLE: 71° FORKS: Chromoly Steerer Tube and Tapered Hi-Ten Legs BARS: - MATERIAL: Hi-Ten - TYPE: 2-Piece - RISE: 9" Rise - WIDTH: 29" Width STEM: Alloy Top Load HEADSET: Integrated BRAKE MOUNTS: Removable BRAKES: U-Brake FRONT HUB: 10mm Sealed FRONT RIM: Single Wall REAR HUB: 14mm Sealed Cassette REAR RIM: Single Wall TYRES: 2.3" SPROCKET: 25t CRANKS: - MATERIAL: Chromoly - TYPE: 3-Piece - ARM LENGTH: 170mm BB: 19mm Mid PEDALS: Nylon/Fiberglass SEAT: Combo Seat/Post GEARING: 25/9 WEIGHT: 24.69lbs (11.2kg) ###section### Product Highlights Great for riders who are between 5ft and 6ft tall (150cm - 180cm) A great all rounder suitable for any type of riding Built strong and lightweight Strong and durable crankset Sealed bearings throughout ###shogun-image-section###
